# Power Portals Pro — Public Issue Tracker

Welcome! This repository exists solely as the **public issue tracker** for **[Power Portals Pro](https://powerportalspro.com)**.

Because the main product codebase is private, this repository provides a place for customers and partners to:

- Report bugs  
- Request new features  
- Ask questions  
- Track progress on upcoming improvements  

## How to Use This Repository

### 🐞 Report a Bug
Open an Issue using the **Bug Report** template.  
Please include:
- Steps to reproduce  
- Expected behavior  
- Actual behavior  
- Screenshots or recordings (if applicable)  

### 💡 Request a Feature
Use the **Feature Request** template.  
Tell us:
- What problem you're trying to solve  
- Why it matters  
- Any examples or context  

### ❓ Ask a Question
Use the **General Question** template.

## 🔒 About the Main Codebase
The primary Power Portals Pro repository is private.  
This public tracker allows us to collaborate openly without exposing proprietary code.

## 📬 Thank You
Your feedback directly shapes the roadmap.  
We appreciate your time and contributions.
